request: User (14 Oct 2026): R-008 browser view is better and performs well with soft shadows off, but still not photorealistic. Open to a new library or to rendering outside the browser.
audit_findings: Browser real-time rendering cannot do true global illumination; light does not bounce, so surfaces look uniformly lit.
GLB textures are 512 px, too soft for close views.
R-008 Cycles stills were over-exposed and cream-on-cream with little tonal range.
geometry_policy: No change to any geometry. Only texture resolution, lighting, camera and render settings.
decision: Primary photoreal route is offline Blender Cycles (free app). The browser walkthrough stays as the fast layout tool. No new JS library added.
deliverables: drafts/R-009/render-kit: jaipur-first-floor.blend (Day and Evening scenes, 27 cameras), tex/, render.py, render-jaipur.sh, README.md, previews/
drafts/R-009/tools: build_blend.py, bake_ultra.cjs, texmap.py, realism.js (ultra-quality bake)
drafts/R-009/render-kit/renders/final-cloud: 10 cloud-rendered stills (Living, Master, Kitchen, Bedroom 2, Bedroom 3; Day and Evening), 1200x800, 96 samples, PNG+JPG
limits_to_state_honestly: Simple furniture forms limit realism regardless of renderer.
Not yet rendered on the user's Mac, timings unmeasured.
Colour transform is Khronos PBR Neutral (the cloud Blender build has no AgX config); AgX may look better on the user's Blender but was not verified.
validation_done: Geometry unchanged: scene built from the R-008 GLB, no mesh edits (author check).
Six test renders (Living, Master, Kitchen, day and evening) inspected by author.
Ten 1200x800 renders inspected by author; Bedroom 2 daylight re-rendered at +1.4 EV (no direct sun reaches it).
known_issues: Navy rectangle above the Living passage in evening views is a baseline model element, not fixed here.
Thin brown sliver beside the Bedroom 3 AC (baseline geometry, unconfirmed).
1200x800 at 96 samples is the most the 2-core cloud machine can do; Mac GPU at 2400x1600/512 samples (render-jaipur.sh final) will be cleaner.
render_settings: Cycles, Khronos PBR Neutral, window light portals, sun 1.5 deg, indirect clamp off, OIDN denoise
